classification: Separate post-v1 disclosed development proposal; not a retune or blind study.

diagnostic_basis.pickup_gain: At the 1.461 s source edge, the causal controller estimator was valid and assigned 1.0 of payload support to the carried arm; observed table normal was 0 N.
diagnostic_basis.tool_counterexample: At the 3.857 s source edge, the same estimator was valid but assigned only 0.3047 of payload support to the arm while measured table normal was 27.28 N.
diagnostic_basis.proposal: Acquire the optional gripped inverse-force episode only while the actual controller's causal support estimate is valid and at least half of payload support remains carried by the arm. Half-weight is a physical ownership boundary, not selected from a missed-force magnitude or timestamp. Under invalid/uncertain support, C1 passes through unchanged.

source.normal_model: Reuse the frozen v1 inverse-force model fit only on seven normal G4 episodes.
source.support_feature: shared_estimator.lambda_support and lambda_support_valid from the unmodified G4 controller, sampled causally before the current controller update.
source.arbitration: Never suppress or delay C1. The optional episode may start only when support-valid and arm-support >= 0.5; incumbent ownership and physical rearm remain v1-identical.

prepositive_gates.separated_normal_audit: All six v1 audit normals must have byte-identical C1 rise/active/false/tool/cost/physics.
prepositive_gates.source_pins: Freeze support_plan.json, support_aware.py and the reused model before any challenged output.

postfreeze_panels.authentic_official: All 29 stock evaluate.py episodes per C1/support-aware arm; retain at least 17/24 and no control/false regression.
postfreeze_panels.signed_pair: The frozen v1 signed X/Y/Z and two-impulse panel; no inherited loss, added duplicate or changed physics.
postfreeze_panels.known_tool: The disclosed tool_high/tool_lateral/tool_low guard must have no new rise.
postfreeze_panels.postrelease: C1 post-release late signed X/Z behavior must remain byte-identical because the support-aware source is gripped-only.

falsifier: Reject without another threshold alternative for any separated-normal change, official gain loss below 17/24, new false/duplicate/tool rise, inherited delay >5 ms, changed physics/controller cells, or failed signed/pair/post-release protection.
